name: McDonald's
description: Since 1954, McDonald's has been dedicated to serving quality food and quick service at an affordable price for our customers. Visit your nearby McDonald's and choose from a menu of favorites, including McCafé® coffee, tasty breakfasts, delicious burgers like our Quarter Pounder®* with Cheese and more! Restaurants nationwide offer numerous amenities to ensure every customer has an enjoyable experience. Find out if your local nearby McDonald's is open 24 hours, offers Drive Thru or McDelivery®**, and more through the McDonald's restaurant locator. Before you head out, check out the deals page for our latest offers and order your food ahead with Mobile Order & Pay†, available exclusively on the McDonald's app! Next time you're looking for a treat, head to a McDonald's nearby, we look forward to serving you!
